name: Jungle Stone Bloods
description: The Jungle Stone Bloods (JSB) are a Blood-affiliated set in Detroit linked to the Almighty Black P. Stone Nation (BPSN) and aligned with the People Nation (5X). JSB migrated to Detroit around the early 2000s and operate primarily on the city's westside around the Seven Mile & Telegraph corridor (48219 ZIP) and the Seven Mile–Rouge corridor. The group is considered part of one of Detroit's more structured Blood-affiliated organizations, with affiliated cliques including the Schoolcraft Boyz (SCB). JSB maintains documented rivalries with Crip-affiliated groups, particularly the 5Point Nation Crips.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of 5Point Nation Crips (5PN) in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
